gloss: communication speed; data transfer rate; connection speed

definitions.gloss: communication speed; data transfer rate; connection speed
definitions.explanation: The rate at which data is transferred over a network connection, typically measured in bits per second. Commonly used when talking about internet and mobile connections.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{通信|つうしん}→通信：03514_tsuushin⟧ (communication, telecommunications) and ⟦{速度|そくど}→速度：03319_sokudo⟧ (speed). A standard term in discussions of internet plans, mobile data, and network performance. Japanese mobile carriers advertise maximum {通信速度|つうしんそくど} in their plans, and the word frequently appears in customer support contexts when users complain about slow connections.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通信速度|つうしんそくど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{速|はや}い→速い：00514_hayai⟧/⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧: the connection speed is fast/slow
- {通信速度|つうしんそくど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧: to measure the connection speed
- {通信速度|つうしんそくど}⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧: speed throttling, bandwidth limit
- ⟦{最大|さいだい}→最大：04827_saidai⟧{通信速度|つうしんそくど}: maximum connection speed
- {通信速度|つうしんそくど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低下|ていか}→低下：04065_teika⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: the connection speed drops
